app_key.description: This app_key is the one you receive upon onboarding your paybill to the Daraja Platform.

resmsg.description: This is a message from the API that gives the status of the request processing and usually maps to a specific result code value.

rescode.description: This is a numeric status code that indicates the status of the transaction processing. 200 means success and any other code means an error occurred or the transaction failed.
